_doc: Single source of truth for the drift-prone currency literals shared across the relay's compiled catalog (crates/dpay-relay/src/catalog.rs ic_rows — the SOLE catalog authority since the founder's 2026-08-28 registry removal) and the app's BUNDLED_NETWORKS icp-mainnet rows (app/config/catalog.ts; the flat BUNDLED_CATALOG view is DERIVED via icpCatalogOf since Catalog v2 2026-08-27 — there is exactly one bundled shape, the network-first one). Cross-checked by: (1) the Rust #[cfg(test)] drift-alarm in catalog.rs (catalog_truth_tests — pins EVERY IC row's ledger/minter principal, ids, order and locked shape), (2) a jest drift-alarm in app/__tests__/catalog.test.ts. A drift in either direction goes RED. Since the 2026-08-28 REAL-rows transplant the relay's ic_rows are the VERBATIM live-prod rows (fetched from prod /api/v1/currencies 2026-08-28) + the locked 7/8 rows, so this file is money-defining config, not just fallback alignment. The decimals.eth entry pins the 18-dec ckETH row (currency id 6 in BUNDLED_CATALOG, id 6 in ic_rows). The cketh_ledger principal (the native-ckETH ICRC ledger) is the SAME principal as cketh_gas_ledger (the ckETH ledger also serves as the gas source for ckERC20 cash-out). The testnet_* entries pin the real IC-testnet chain-key canisters (ckTESTBTC ledger/minter, Sepolia ckUSDC/ckETH ledgers + the Sepolia ckETH minter — currencies 3/4/5). The vchf_ledger/icp_ledger entries pin the two complete no-minter direct-ICRC assets (currency ids 7/8, added 2026-08-28 — see docs/specs/2026-08-28-vchf-icp-support-spec.md); icp_index is the OFFICIAL ICP index canister pinned by the relay's agent_ledger.rs ICP history adapter (a code pin, deliberately NOT a catalog field — no generic index_canister abstraction until a second ledger needs one). The eurc_mint principal + decimals.eurc entry pin the solana EURC asset (added 2026-09-06 as EUR dual-rail Stage 1; sole EUR rail since the 2026-09-19 VEUR removal — veur_ledger/decimals.veur were dropped with the retired currency-9 row, an id never reused); eurc_mint lives under principals (not a dedicated mints object) because the spec locked it there alongside the other money-defining addresses. The wire_consts object is the canister half (cross-checked by a Rust #[cfg(test)] drift-alarm in crates/dpay-canister/src/types.rs + a jest drift-alarm added by the app side): RETRIEVE_BTC_MIN_AMOUNT mirrors types.rs and the relay's ckBTC withdraw floor; MINT_ACCOUNT (32 bytes of 0xFF) mirrors types.rs and the relay's MINT sentinel / the app's MINT_HEX.

venues._doc: The VENUE REGISTRY (multi-venue readiness Wave 1, 2026-09-10): per venue — identity (venue_id, display_name), kind, the dpay-chosen endpoint contract, the pair as an UNORDERED set of ledger principals, environment, and the disclosure copy key. The fee tier is deliberately NOT here: production reads it off the venue at quote time and echoes it (the relay never claims a number the venue did not say). `pair_ledgers` order carries NO meaning — which side a pool calls token0 is the venue's own fact, read live per quote; pinning an order here is exactly the 2026-09-07 defect (docs/specs/2026-09-08-conversion-hardening-plan.md). `kind` is an extensible string enum: ic_amm today, cefi next, a future solana kind is a new value — not a schema break. Compiled into the relay catalog (crates/dpay-relay/src/catalog.rs venues) and served at GET /api/v1/venues; bundled app-side (app/config/venues.ts); both sides drift-alarmed against this file.

fixture._doc: MEASURED 2026-09-08 off the LIVE pool's own `metadata` query (anonymous, read-only, https://icp-api.io). NOT a production input: production reads token0/token1/fee off the pool at request time (crates/dpay-relay/src/agent_ledger.rs swap_pool_metadata), because a remote system's pair order is a fact to read, never a constant to assume. This block exists for exactly two jobs: (1) it is the order the OFFLINE fake-IC stub pool is seeded in (crates/dpay-relay/src/ic_gateway.rs FakeIc::from_catalog), pinned by the Rust drift alarm in catalog.rs so the fake can never again agree with a stale pin instead of with the venue; (2) `just swap-venue-probe` asserts the LIVE pool still reports exactly these values.

venues._doc: OFFLINE TEST FIXTURE — NOT A REAL VENUE, never probe it on mainnet. An invented canister id (no such canister exists on any network) that exists so the offline loop can hold TWO venues on the same pair through the fake-IC gateway: same VCHF/ICP pair, deliberately REVERSED seed order (token0 = ICP — the direction logic must not assume one order across pools) and a different fee tier (1000 = 0.10%). `testnet: true` labels it what it is — an invented test stand-in, not a mainnet venue. The `test_helpers_served` marker (multi-venue readiness V5, 2026-09-11) keeps it out of the mainnet tripwire and out of the AGENT (prod) build entirely (never in GET /api/v1/venues, never in the quote allowlist); the OFFLINE test-helpers relay may serve it behind the POST /api/v1/test/venue knob, so the default experience stays one venue until a test opts in.

The FIRST SOLANA venue (registered 2026-09-15, multi-venue readiness V11 — 'a Solana venue cannot reach the screen'): Jupiter, the autonomous on-chain Solana aggregator, for the rail-local pair SOL ↔ USDC(Solana). IDENTIFIER SEMANTICS for a solana_amm row: `pair_ledgers` are Solana MINTS in base58 (the eurc_mint precedent for base58 identifiers in this file), NOT IC ledger principals — the SOL side is identified by the WRAPPED-SOL mint So111…12 because that is the stable string id a venue route carries for native SOL (a registry row needs an identifier per side; 'null', the payment rail's marker for native SOL, is not one). `endpoint` is an https ORIGIN, not a principal — since 2026-09-16 (founder ask 'get live quotes from them … possibly through our relay (for caching etc)') it is the venue's IDENTITY and attribution only (it renders in the pool line), NOT a dial target: the quote is a keyless GET piped through the relay's Jupiter proxy (crates/dpay-relay/src/jupiter.rs — byte-faithful, short-TTL cache keyed on canonical sorted query params; upstream error statuses pass through verbatim, transport death is 504 jupiter-upstream-unreachable) and the swap is Jupiter's serialized unsigned transaction, signed on-device, built through the relay's never-cached swap POST — the relay's registry role stands (served in /api/v1/venues with kind solana_amm; never resolvable through venue_of_endpoint, the IC quote allowlist). NO FIXTURE by rule: fixtures are the ic_amm offline-fake-IC seeding and are ic_amm-only — the offline Jupiter stand-in is the relay's own test stub upstream (harness/relay.mjs points DPAY_JUPITER_API_BASE at /api/v1/test/jupiter-upstream), so this row carries no fixture block at all. Measured live 2026-09-14 (docs/specs/2026-09-14-swap-venue-feasibility.md): lite-api.jup.ag quote/swap are keyless, no KYC, platformFee null (no integrator fee).

The SECOND Solana venue (registered 2026-09-16, convert coverage expansion — docs/specs/2026-09-16-convert-coverage-expansion.md §1): the same Jupiter aggregator family as the row above, on the rail-local pair SOL ↔ EURC. Identifier semantics match the jupiter row (mints in base58, https-origin endpoint as identity with relay-proxied dials, no fixture — the offline stand-in is the relay's test stub upstream). Measured live 2026-09-16: SOL→EURC quotes healthy both directions keyless (~110 ms, platformFee null). (The USDC↔EURC pair probed 2026-09-16 was SKIPPED on a then-apparent ~13% spread — an artifact of comparing against 1:1 USD/EUR parity; re-measured 2026-09-19 against the real EUR/USD rate (~1.17) it is fair and REGISTERED as jupiter-usdc-eurc.)

The THIRD Solana venue (registered 2026-09-19, EUR↔USD completion — founder mandate that EUR↔USD conversion exists): the same Jupiter aggregator family, on the rail-local pair USDC ↔ EURC. Identifier semantics match the jupiter rows (mints in base58, UNORDERED — the canonical USDC mint and the EURC mint; https-origin endpoint as identity with relay-proxied dials; no fixture — the offline stand-in is the relay's test stub upstream). Measured live 2026-09-19: 10 USDC → 8.698735 EURC (direct DefiTuna pool, priceImpactPct 0.000002) and 8.6 EURC → 9.885319 USDC (Whirlpool), keyless, platformFee null — both directions within ~2-3% of fair at EUR/USD ~1.17; the 2026-09-16 '13% spread' skip verdict was an artifact of comparing against 1:1 parity.

The FIRST CeFi venue (registered 2026-09-15, founder decision 3 — the relay-held partner-key pattern, docs/specs/2026-09-14-swap-venue-feasibility.md §Partner-key infrastructure): SideShift, an automated instant-exchange service, on the cross-rail pair ICP ↔ SOL. IDENTIFIER SEMANTICS for a cefi row: `pair_ledgers` are RAIL-CANONICAL ids — the IC side by ledger principal, the Solana side by MINT (native SOL = the wrapped-SOL mint, the jupiter row's own precedent for naming native SOL in a registry row) — while the VENUE's own coin/network codes (ICP/icp, SOL/solana) live with the venue integration (crates/dpay-relay/src/sideshift.rs), not here. `endpoint` is the venue's https API BASE (verified live 2026-09-15: the old api.sideshift.ai host is NXDOMAIN; the API lives under sideshift.ai/api/v2). UNLIKE every other row this venue needs a partner credential: quote and fixed-order creation run through the relay's sideshift proxy (DPAY_SIDESHIFT_SECRET / DPAY_SIDESHIFT_AFFILIATE_ID — the account secret attaches relay-side, the device never sees it; both may be unset, in which case the proxy answers 503 naming them and the venue is simply absent), while shift STATUS reads are SideShift's own KEYLESS GET the device polls directly (app/convertResume.ts provider path — verified live 2026-09-15). NO FIXTURE by the same rule as the jupiter row: fixtures are the ic_amm offline-fake-IC seeding; this row's offline stand-ins are the relay's /api/v1/test/sideshift-upstream stub (harness/relay.mjs points DPAY_SIDESHIFT_API_BASE at it) and the e2e page fetch stub on the sideshift.ai origin (e2e/harness/sideshift.mjs). Founder boundary: the partner account holds no funds and dpay sends none to it (nothing to withdraw); commissionRate pinned to 0 (dpay is paid nothing); withdrawal-capable keys remain an absolute no.

The SECOND CeFi venue (registered 2026-09-16, convert coverage expansion — docs/specs/2026-09-16-convert-coverage-expansion.md §1): the same SideShift venue family as the row above, on the cross-rail pair ICP ↔ USDC(Solana) — the first pair with two registered routes (this beside the CCTP multihop Route B out of the ckUSDC leg). Identifier semantics match the sideshift row (rail-canonical pair ids, https API base, relay-held partner key: quote/order ride the proxy, status reads stay device-direct keyless, no fixture). The USDC(Solana) mint → SideShift coin/network mapping in crates/dpay-relay/src/sideshift.rs is best-effort and UNVERIFIED until the founder's partner key exists — the keyless 503 tripwire applies to this row exactly as to its sibling.

The THIRD CeFi venue (registered 2026-09-19, the EUR→IC bridge): the same SideShift venue family as the rows above, on the cross-rail pair ICP ↔ EURC(Solana) — the pair that completes dpay's EUR rail: EURC (the user deposits on Solana) ⇄ ICP (settles on the Internet Computer), the only registered route between the two. Identifier semantics match the sideshift rows (rail-canonical pair ids, https API base, relay-held partner key: quote/order ride the proxy, status reads stay device-direct keyless, no fixture). The PAIR is verified keyless 2026-09-19: GET /api/v2/pair/eurc-solana/icp AND /api/v2/pair/icp/eurc-solana both answer live (the reverse direction min 3.50126051, rate 2.437182922012), confirming the venue's own coin/network codes (eurc/solana, ICP/icp) mapped in crates/dpay-relay/src/sideshift.rs. Quoting 503s until the relay holds the founder partner key (sops-encrypted, secrets/sideshift.sops.json — prod deployment of it remains founder-run); the keyless 503 tripwire applies to this row exactly as to its siblings.
